column4: Ella blowing on a steaming hot bowl of soup, little wavy heat lines rising, her cheeks pink from the heat.
Leo shivering in the snow in a scarf and woolly hat, teeth chattering, frosty breath, snowflakes falling.
Ella zooming super fast on a kick scooter, hair streaming back, speed lines and a puff of dust behind her.
A snail crawling very slowly along a leaf, a long shiny trail behind it.
Ben banging a big drum very loudly, mouth wide open shouting, bold sound waves (no letters) bursting out.
Mia tiptoeing with a finger on her lips going shh, next to a sleeping kitten in a basket.
A very tall giraffe standing next to Ella; Ella looks way up at its head high above.
A tiny ant standing on Leo's fingertip; Leo looks at it closely with a magnifying glass.
A huge elephant standing next to little Leo, who only reaches its knee.
Ella happily licking a big swirly lollipop, a few sweets and a cupcake beside her.
Leo biting into a lemon slice, his face scrunched up and puckered from the sour taste.
Ella soaking wet in the rain without an umbrella, hair and clothes dripping, standing in a puddle.
Ben eating a red chilli pepper, his face bright red, little puffs of steam from his ears, fanning his open mouth.
A shiny gold trophy cup sparkling and gleaming with bright highlights and little twinkles.
Mia's hands covered in sticky golden honey dripping in long strings from a honey jar.
Ella hugging a big fluffy white sheep with soft, cloud-like wool.
Leo straining with all his might to lift a very heavy suitcase, red-faced, knees bent.
Ella pressing her cheek into a big soft fluffy pillow, eyes closed, smiling.
A cactus in a pot covered with long sharp spines, and a freshly sharpened pencil with a very pointy tip beside it.
A big round orange beach ball, perfectly round, on the sand.
Mia wearing a very, very long striped scarf that trails far along the floor behind her.
Leo holding up a very dirty pair of sneakers covered in mud, wrinkling his nose.
Ella fresh and clean after a bath, wrapped in a towel, sparkles around her, shining clean skin.
Ben in a dark room at night holding a flashlight, the beam of light the only bright thing.
A very bright sunny day; Ella squints and shades her eyes from the dazzling bright sun.
Leo holding a broken toy car whose wheel has come off, a crack in its body, looking sad.
Grandma sitting in a rocking chair with her knitting, smiling, an old grandfather clock beside her.
Ben holding his nose next to a very smelly rubbish bin with flies buzzing around and wavy green smell lines.
Dad showing his strong arm muscles, lifting Leo up high with one arm, both laughing.
A very cute fluffy baby bunny with big shiny eyes and floppy ears, sitting in the grass.
Portrait of Ella feeling happy, big joyful smile, arms up.
Portrait of Leo feeling sad, a tear on his cheek, head down.
Portrait of Ben feeling angry, frowning, cheeks puffed, arms crossed, stamping a foot.
Portrait of Mia feeling scared, hands up near her face, wide eyes, shaking.
Portrait of Ella feeling sleepy, eyes half closed, yawning, hugging her teddy bear.
Portrait of Leo feeling surprised, eyebrows up, mouth in a big O, hands on cheeks.
Portrait of Ben being silly, making a funny face with his tongue out and fingers wiggling at his ears.
Ella feeling sick in bed with a thermometer in her mouth, an ice pack on her forehead, pale and tired.
A turtle walking very slowly along a path, a few little dust puffs, tiny careful steps.
A rabbit running very fast across a meadow, ears back, speed lines behind it.
A lion roaring very loudly, mouth wide open, big sound waves (no letters) blasting out, birds flying away.
A little mouse tiptoeing very quietly past a sleeping cat.
Ella smiling happily in a sunny garden, holding a flower.
Leo crying sadly, sitting on the ground with a scraped knee, tears falling.
A rocket blasting off and flying straight up into the blue sky, a long trail of smoke below it.
An autumn leaf falling down from a tree, gently drifting toward the ground, dotted path showing its way down.
A kangaroo jumping very high in the air over a bush.
A snail moving very slowly up a garden step, a long shiny trail behind it.
A fish swimming happily under the sea among bubbles and seaweed.
A bird flying high in the blue sky with its wings spread.
A happy dog running fast across the grass, ears flapping.
A green frog jumping high off a lily pad.
Ella reading a picture book on a cushion.
Leo singing a song, music notes floating around him.
Ella eating a big red apple, taking a crunchy bite.
Leo drinking a glass of milk.
Ella sleeping peacefully in her bed under a blanket.
Leo drawing a picture of a cat with crayons on paper.
A fish swimming happily in the sea.
A puzzled fish in the sea peeking out of the water and looking up at birds flying in the sky above, wishing it could fly.
A bird flying in the sky with its wings spread wide.
A penguin on the ice flapping its little flippers hard but its feet stay on the ground, birds flying in the sky above it.
A penguin swimming fast underwater, streamlined, with bubbles.
A frog jumping high off a lily pad.
A snake with no legs looking puzzled at a pair of small sneakers on the ground.
A snail at the start line of a running track, far behind, with running children far ahead in the distance.
A horse running fast across a field, mane flying.
A duck swimming on a pond, ripples around it.
A dog sitting on a hill looking up longingly at birds flying in the sky, its feet on the ground.
A big heavy elephant standing in front of a trampoline, looking at it doubtfully, too heavy to jump.
